name: Example support chatbot
description: A customer-support chatbot for a fictional web shop. Users type free-text questions about orders and returns. The bot is a single LLM call with a system prompt that sets its role; it can look up an order's status by order number through one read-only API, and it cannot issue refunds or change data.
deployment: Public website widget, roughly 2,000 conversations per day.
data: Order numbers and delivery status. Users may type their own name and e-mail address into the chat.
model: A hosted commercial LLM, version not pinned.
unknowns: Whether the system prompt contains anything confidential
